mapper.select: SELECT id, credit_code, vat_type, individual_tax_code FROM financial.fxy_financial_account_sets WHERE credit_code IN #{t}

SELECT id, account_set_id, name, phone, password, login_type, id_card, is_default, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM financial.tax_officer WHERE account_set_id IN #{id} ORDER BY account_set_id, is_default DESC, id ASC

SELECT id, account_set_id, name, phone, password, login_type, id_card, is_default, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM financial.tax_officer WHERE account_set_id = #{accountSetId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, id ASC

SELECT t.account_sets_id, t.result, t.failed_reason FROM financial.individual_tax t INNER JOIN ( SELECT account_sets_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM financial.individual_tax WHERE account_sets_id IN #{id} GROUP BY account_sets_id ) latest ON t.id = latest.max_id
